creator: Edmonia Lewis
title: The Death of Cleopatra
credit: Gift of the Historical Society of Forest Park, Illinois
rights: Public Domain / Smithsonian Open Access images
alts: Museum view 1: a marble figure of Cleopatra slumps on a throne with carved sphinx heads on its arms; her head tilts to one side.
Museum view 2: the same sculpture from a different angle, showing the throne's side and the fall of drapery across the figure.
presentation: Two distinct museum photographs of one sculpture, side by side where space permits and stacked on narrow screens. Neither is a synthesized angle; the pair is not a complete three-dimensional encounter.
